verdict.rationale: Munito AI documents native support for the OpenAI Chat Completions API (plus the Anthropic Messages API). Migration needs only a change of base URL, key and model ID, so an agent can switch to or away from it without provider-specific code. Tool calls and streaming are listed capabilities, and agent clients such as Codex and OpenCode are documented as connectable. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of drop-in compatibility, and detail on parameter and response parity or known deviations from the OpenAI spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an agent switch to or away from this provider mid-workflow because it speaks the standard chat-completions API without provider-specific code changes

citations.quote: Move from the OpenAI or Anthropic SDK. Change the base URL, the key and the model ID.
Munito AI supports the OpenAI Chat Completions, Responses and speech to text APIs, plus the Anthropic Messages API.
through the OpenAI-compatible or the Anthropic-compatible API
Capabilities: structured outputs, tool calls, vision, speech to text, streaming, reasoning and prompt caching.
